create_DensePoseChartResult: create a DensePoseChartResult dataclass with labels and UV coordinate tensors for chart-based DensePose results
create_DensePoseChartResultWithConfidenc: create a DensePoseChartResultWithConfidences dataclass with optional sigma, kappa, and segmentation confidence tensors
quantize_densepose_chart_result: quantize a DensePoseChartResult by scaling UV coordinates to uint8 range 0-255 and packing with labels
compress_quantized_densepose_chart_resul: compress a quantized DensePose chart result into a PNG-encoded Base64 string for storage or transmission
decompress_compressed_densepose_chart_re: decompress a Base64-encoded PNG string back into a quantized DensePose chart result tensor
